people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: One runner will run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is taken on every quarter.
translations.bsb: One courier races to meet another, and messenger follows messenger, to announce to the king of Babylon that his city has been captured from end to end.
translations.kjv: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,
